content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Trenton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a specific combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the hours and educational level required. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess whether your background qualifies before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. This formal education meets PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and covers the full PMBOK Guide framework. Our Trenton cohorts are scheduled to fit working professionals' calendars without compromising depth or engagement.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the boot camp, apply directly to PMI and pay the examination fee through PMI's official portal. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application completion and documentation. PMI will review your eligibility and grant authorization to schedule your exam once approved.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor office hours to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your PMP exam at a PMI-authorized testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer technical questions as you move toward test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP renewal requires earning professional development units (PDUs) over a standard three-year cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible workshops and webinars to support your continuous learning. Track your PDUs through PMI's system and renew before your credential expires.
